authoring: Outcome-informed retrospective. Candidate titles, bodies, patches and immutable source transitions were inspected before these bounded facets were selected.

network.correction: At the landed Claude transition, engine domain sets are already explicit network.allowed opt-ins, not unconditional access. Preserve v1; do not describe this as removal from every workflow's automatic defaults.
network.quantity: Distinct concrete infrastructure domains no longer granted by the named claude transport set while still independently available through explicit containers, linux-distros or playwright opt-in.
network.acceptance: Compare actual-parent and landed-commit JSON plus the Go embed/loader/named-set resolution at both revisions. Count a concrete prior Claude entry only if covered by a retained infrastructure category, absent from all after-Claude host/subdomain patterns, and the entire ecosystems map is unchanged. Wildcard entries are not finite native domains and are excluded. Deduplicate engine/domain across the lifetime.
network.conservativeMatching: Treat both literal suffixes and wildcard suffixes as covering descendant hosts; conservatively treat wildcard apex as covered for after-state rejection. No claim about actual outbound traffic or all compiler configurations.
network.notAccepted: Style changes, loader refactors, new labels, or unchanged effective named-set coverage.
network.fullAcceptance: Unknown; no historical full compiler, egress or engine-functionality replay.

setup.quantity: Distinct independently reproduced credential-at-rest condition repairs, not the number of test cases.

conditions.acceptance: Run only the original source's origin-URL assignment and original git remote-add statement against an isolated local empty Git repository and a non-secret marker. The marker is persisted in the old .git/config but absent from the new .git/config, and the new origin still names the same HTTPS target. Never clone or contact that target.

Run the unchanged native wrapper generator and original source's bounded wrapper-write statements in an isolated directory using a dummy API-key marker. Independently stat/read the file on fresh creation and replacement of a pre-existing 0755 file. Both old cases retain group/world readability; both new cases retain the marker and owner execution without group/world readability. Count one repaired condition, not two cases.

setup.limitations: These are bounded differential reproductions of the concrete filesystem condition, not complete action execution, network authentication, sandbox isolation, race freedom, symlink safety or comprehensive regression acceptance.

model.retained: Original v1 acceptance is unchanged. No replacement proxy based on declarations, reports or successful jobs is introduced.
model.gap: The discovered workflow-linked objects are failed/incomplete investigations. Two independent original job graphs prove preparation-step failure, not native model-boundary acceptance. Source model history exists but is not itself an independently completed TLC replay.
